name: Contour Extraction in Fourier Space
definition: A method to enhance Fourier Volume Rendering by extracting and emphasizing material boundaries (contours) in volumetric datasets. It solves the problem of occlusion-free FVR images being difficult to interpret by weighting samples based on gradient magnitude and viewing angle to highlight surfaces perpendicular to the view.
summary: Contour Extraction in Fourier Space enhances Fourier Volume Rendering by weighting samples with gradient magnitude and a sine transfer function to emphasize material boundaries and surface orientation.
